title: Tangent Line to a Reciprocal Curve
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the slope of the curve y = 1/x at the point P(2, 1/2), and find the equation of the tangent line to the curve at this point.

steps.title: Formulate the Slope as a Limit of Difference Quotient
steps.explanation: Substitute x0 = 2 into the definition of curve slope using f(x) = 1/x.
steps.why: The slope of the tangent line is the limit of secant line slopes.

steps.title: Combine Fractions with Common Denominator
steps.explanation: Find a common denominator of 2(2+h) in the numerator.
steps.why: Simplifying rational expressions enables cancellation of the division-by-zero factor.

steps.title: Cancel h and Evaluate the Limit
steps.explanation: Divide numerator and denominator by h and evaluate at h = 0.
steps.why: Canceling the factor of h removes the indeterminate form 0/0.

steps.title: Write the Tangent Line Equation
steps.explanation: Apply the point-slope form with point (2, 1/2) and slope m = -1/4.
steps.why: Point-slope equation defines a unique straight line passing through a given point with given slope.
